headline: Record revenue and profit surge on AI infrastructure demand
summary_short: Astera Labs posted record revenue of $392.4M, up 104% y/y and 27% q/q, as diluted EPS more than doubled to $0.83 on broad-based AI-fabric and signal-conditioning demand; Q3 guidance of $540-560M implies another leg up.
summary_long: Revenue rose 104% y/y (27% q/q) to $392.4M on broad-based AI-fabric and signal-conditioning demand, including record Aries revenue. GAAP operating margin expanded to 22.7% from 20.7% as opex grew slower than sales; a swing to a net tax benefit helped push net income to $153.1M and diluted EPS to $0.83. Cash fell to $111.5M as the company invested $359.7M in marketable securities and paid $69.2M for an acquisition, against $162.3M of operating cash flow. Management guides Q3 revenue to $540-560M and non-GAAP diluted EPS to $1.16-$1.21, citing the Scorpio X-Series fabric-switch ramp arriving a quarter early.

drivers.explanation: Broad-based growth across AI fabrics and signal conditioning, including record quarterly Aries product-line revenue; management cites diversified customer demand rather than one product.
Tracks net income's rise; basic share count grew only slightly, so nearly all of the net-income gain flowed through to per-share earnings.
Not explained in the release; no cost-of-revenue commentary is given beyond the reported dollar figure.
Absolute gross profit grew with revenue, but GAAP gross margin compressed to 73.3% from 75.8% y/y and 76.3% q/q; the release does not state a cause for the margin decline.
Operating expenses grew slower (+87% y/y) than revenue (+104% y/y), expanding GAAP operating margin to 22.7% from 20.7% a year ago.
Followed operating income higher, plus interest and other income rose to $13.6M from $10.9M a year ago.
Operating income growth was amplified by a $50.3M income tax benefit this quarter versus a $0.6M benefit a year ago; the release does not explain the tax-benefit driver.
Net income nearly tripled while diluted shares rose only 2.9% y/y, so almost all of the net-income gain reached diluted EPS.
Cash fell as $359.7M went into marketable-securities purchases and $69.2M was paid for a business acquisition, against $162.3M of operating cash flow.
Retained earnings grew with YTD net income of $233.4M and additional paid-in capital rose on $112.9M of YTD stock-based compensation; no buybacks were disclosed.
Share count rose modestly on stock-option exercises and employee stock purchase plan issuances reported in the cash-flow financing section; no buyback was disclosed to offset it.

Management attributes the quarter to diversified, broad-based demand across the portfolio and says Q3 momentum will accelerate as Scorpio fabric switches become the largest product family a quarter earlier than expected.
